_about: Gold set for evals/run_retrieval_evals.py. Each case is pinned to one filing (by fiscal year) so new filings never change the expected answer. A retrieved passage is a hit if it contains any gold snippet (case, whitespace and curly quotes ignored). gold_sections are substrings of the expected section label. Questions are paraphrased on purpose: copying the filing's wording would flatter retrieval.
